title: What movement does each of the ten expressions give?
description: Ten expressions, each a target floor take away a starting floor, are completed by asking how far and which way the lift must go. They are solved in four groups, by where the two floors lie, and every answer is checked by adding the movement to the starting floor.
teaching_notes: One idea: each expression is the target floor take away the starting floor, and its answer is the movement the lift makes. Watch for students who write the floors the other way round and get the opposite sign.

video_script.why: The child completes ten expressions by finding the movement from the starting floor to the target floor, as in the book's example.
video_script.substitution: The ten expressions of the book question, solved in four groups by where the two floors lie.
video_script.anchor: the lift shaft of Ruhee with floors above and below the ground
video_script.payoff_line: Each movement is the target floor take away the starting floor.

final_answer.spoken: negative three, negative two, positive three, positive two, positive seven, negative one, negative three, zero, negative two and positive six

names.Ruhee: the building with floors above and below the ground

maths_rules: a. (+1) - (+4): from floor 4 down to floor 1, -3
c. (+4) - (+1): from floor 1 up to floor 4, +3
e. (+4) - (-3): from -3 up to 0 is 3, then 4 more, +7
g. (-1) - (+2): from floor 2 down to floor -1, -3
i. (-1) - (+1): from floor 1 down to floor -1, -2
j. (+3) - (-3): from -3 up to 0 is 3, then 3 more, +6
check: starting floor + movement = target floor, for example (+4) + (-3) = +1 and (-2) + (+2) = 0
video_script.design: One shaft, four groups of expressions, and a check line that adds the movement to the starting floor.

beats.on_screen: title card From your book; the lift shaft with floors from -4 to +4 and the first expression (+1) - (+4) = ?

marks.scene: the title card arrives and the lift shaft is drawn
marks.ask: ten expressions slide in as a list
marks.look: the lift stops at floor +4 and floor +1 lights up as the target

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about the lift in Ruhee.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Ten expressions are given, and each asks for the movement needed to reach a target floor.
<bookmark mark='look'/>In the first one, the target floor is positive one, and the starting floor is positive four.
Does the lift go up or down?

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: Target floor - Starting floor = Movement needed, written over the shaft

marks.form: the line Target floor - Starting floor = Movement needed is written
marks.first: the target floor is coloured in the first place, the starting floor in the second

narration: <bookmark mark='form'/>As in the example in your book, each expression is the target floor take away the starting floor.
<bookmark mark='first'/>The target floor comes first, and the answer is the movement needed.

marks.given: the ten expressions are written in two columns

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, ten expressions, each one a target floor take away a starting floor.

beats.on_screen: To find: the movement needed in each

marks.find: the words movement needed are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to complete each expression with the movement needed.

marks.one: the first group is marked: floors on or above the ground
marks.a: an arrow falls from floor 4 to floor 1 and -3 is written
marks.b: an arrow falls from floor 2 to the ground and -2 is written
marks.c: an arrow rises from floor 1 to floor 4 and +3 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Step one, floors on or above the ground.
<bookmark mark='a'/>Positive one take away positive four. The lift goes from floor four down to floor one, so negative three.
<bookmark mark='b'/>Zero take away positive two. The lift goes down two floors to the ground, so negative two.
<bookmark mark='c'/>Positive four take away positive one. The lift goes up three floors, so positive three.

marks.two: the second group is marked: starting floor below the ground
marks.d: an arrow rises from floor -2 to the ground and +2 is written
marks.e: an arrow rises from floor -3 to 0 and then to floor 4, and +7 is written
marks.j: an arrow rises from floor -3 to 0 and then to floor 3, and +6 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='two'/>Step two, starting floors below the ground.
<bookmark mark='d'/>Zero take away negative two. The lift goes up two floors to the ground, so positive two.
<bookmark mark='e'/>Positive four take away negative three. The lift goes up three floors to the ground, then four more, so positive seven.
<bookmark mark='j'/>Positive three take away negative three. The lift goes up three floors, then three more, so positive six.

marks.three: the third group is marked: start above the ground, target below
marks.g: an arrow falls from floor 2 to floor -1 and -3 is written
marks.i: an arrow falls from floor 1 to floor -1 and -2 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='three'/>Step three, starting above the ground and target below it.
<bookmark mark='g'/>Negative one take away positive two. The lift goes from floor two down to floor negative one, so negative three.
<bookmark mark='i'/>Negative one take away positive one. The lift goes down two floors, so negative two.

marks.four: the fourth group is marked: both floors below the ground
marks.f: an arrow falls from floor -3 to floor -4 and -1 is written
marks.h: the lift stays on floor -2 and 0 is written

narration: <bookmark mark='four'/>Step four, both floors below the ground.
<bookmark mark='f'/>Negative four take away negative three. The lift goes one floor down, so negative one.
<bookmark mark='h'/>Negative two take away negative two. The lift stays on the same floor, so the movement is zero.

beats.on_screen: Check: starting floor + movement = target floor;  (+4) + (-3) = +1;  (-2) + (+2) = 0

marks.check: the check line starting floor plus movement equals target floor is written

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>Step five, check by putting the movement back, starting floor plus movement must give the target floor.
<bookmark mark='first'/>In the first one, positive four plus negative three lands on positive one.
<bookmark mark='fourth'/>In the fourth one, negative two plus positive two lands on zero.

marks.rule: the line target floor take away starting floor glows
marks.firstfive: the first five answers are boxed
marks.lastfive: the last five answers are boxed

narration: <bookmark mark='rule'/>Each movement is the target floor take away the starting floor.
<bookmark mark='firstfive'/>The first five are negative three, negative two, positive three, positive two and positive seven.
<bookmark mark='lastfive'/>The last five are negative one, negative three, zero, negative two and positive six.
